1. In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat (do not allow it to brown). Add flour and whisk to form a paste. Continue to cook, stirring, until raw flour scent is gone, about 1 minute. Whisking constantly, add milk in a thin, steady stream, or in increments of a couple of tbsp at a time, whisking thoroughly and getting into all corners of the pan to maintain a homogeneous texture. Sauce will initially become very thick, then get very thin once all the milk is added.

2. Heat, stirring, until sauce comes to a simmer and begins to thicken slightly. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring, until sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a wooden spoon, about 3 minutes.

3. Season with salt and pepper. Add nutmeg to taste, if using. If any lumps form, simply whisk thoroughly to remove them and smooth out sauce, or use a hand blender or countertop blender if lumps are particularly large or tough. Use sauce right away, or press a piece of plastic wrap over surface of sauce to prevent a skin from forming and keep warm until ready to use. Sauce can be cooled and stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator for several days. Reheat very gently on the stovetop or in a microwave to use.

1. V malom kastróliku rozpustíme maslo na stredne silnom až silnom ohni (nesmie zhnednúť). Pridáme múku a metličkou vymiešame na pastu. Za miešania varíme, kým nezmizne vôňa surovej múky, asi 1 minútu. Za stáleho šľahania prilievame mlieko tenkým prúdom alebo po niekoľkých lyžiciach, dôkladne šľaháme a siahame do všetkých kútov kastróla, aby bola omáčka jednoliata. Omáčka najprv veľmi zhustne, po pridaní všetkého mlieka bude veľmi riedka.

2. Za miešania zohrievame, kým omáčka nezačne mierne vrieť a trochu hustnúť. Oheň stlmíme na mierny a za miešania varíme, kým omáčka nie je dosť hustá na to, aby obalila zadnú stranu varešky, asi 3 minúty.

3. Osolíme a okoreníme. Podľa chuti pridáme muškátový oriešok. Ak sa vytvoria hrudky, jednoducho ich dôkladne rozšľaháme metličkou, a ak sú veľké alebo tuhé, použijeme ponorný alebo stolový mixér. Omáčku použijeme hneď, alebo na jej povrch priložíme fóliu, aby sa nevytvorila škrupinka, a do použitia udržiavame teplú. Vychladnutá vydrží v uzavretej nádobe v chladničke niekoľko dní. Pred použitím ju veľmi opatrne zohrejeme na sporáku alebo v mikrovlnnej rúre.

c.t: 3 tomatoes instead of 2 make a thinner, milder sauce. Ñora peppers are traditional; ancho chillies are a good substitute. Almonds and hazelnuts are traditional, but pine nuts or walnuts also work.
S 3 paradajkami namiesto 2 bude omáčka redšia a jemnejšia. Tradičné sú papričky ñora; dobrou náhradou sú papričky ancho. Tradičné sú mandle a lieskovce, ale poslúžia aj píniové alebo vlašské orechy.

en.t: 1 medium head garlic, unpeeled, split in half
30 g dried ñora peppers (about 4) or ancho chili peppers (about 3)
1 slice toasted or stale bread (40 g), any thick and heavy crusts removed, bread broken into small pieces
1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine or sherry vinegar, plus more if desired
80 g skinned and toasted almonds and/or hazelnuts
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil, plus more if desired

1. Preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and place tomatoes and half of garlic head on it. Roast in oven until tomatoes are wrinkled and lightly charred in spots and garlic is soft, about 1 hour. Let cool.

2. Meanwhile, place dried peppers in a medium heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Place a weight or wet paper towel on top to help submerge peppers. Let stand until peppers are fully softened, 30 minutes to 1 hour. If peppers are very stubborn (as thick-skinned ñoras can be), you may need to tear a small hole in them to let water penetrate inside.
3. Drain peppers and discard stems and seeds. Using a paring knife, carefully scrape the flesh from the skins. Discard skins. Peel skins from tomatoes and roasted garlic.

4. To Make Sauce Using a Mortar and Pestle: Add 3 cloves roasted garlic and 1 or 2 cloves peeled raw garlic to mortar. (Feel free to make this recipe more or less garlicky, according to your own tastes, by adding or subtracting roasted or raw garlic.) Smash garlic to a paste with pestle.
5. Add bread and moisten with vinegar. Smash to a paste. Add nuts and smash as finely as you can. The mixture should have the consistency of a rough paste when you're done.

6. Smash in scraped pepper flesh, followed by peeled roasted tomatoes. Mix in olive oil until thoroughly combined. Season with salt. Add more oil, 1 tbsp (15 ml) at a time, if a thinner, richer sauce is desired. Add more vinegar to taste as well.

7. To Make Sauce Using a Countertop Blender or Immersion Blender: Add 3 cloves roasted garlic and 2 cloves peeled raw garlic to jar of blender, or blending container if using an immersion blender. (You can use more or less roasted and raw garlic, as desired, according to your own tastes.) Add nuts. Blend until finely processed, scraping down sides as necessary.

8. Blend in peeled roasted tomatoes and scraped pepper flesh. Add bread, olive oil, and vinegar, and blend until smooth. (How smooth to make it is up to you; some texture is okay.) Season with salt and add more oil and vinegar to taste, if desired.

9. To Make Sauce Using a Food Processor: In the bowl of a food processor, combine 3 cloves roasted garlic and 2 cloves peeled raw garlic (use more or less roasted and raw garlic, as desired, according to your own tastes), along with bread and nuts. Process, scraping down sides as necessary, until finely chopped.

10. Add peeled roasted tomatoes and scraped pepper flesh and process until a thick, rough paste forms. Process in olive oil and vinegar, then season with salt. Add more vinegar and olive oil, as desired, to adjust taste and texture.

2. Medzitým dáme sušené papriky do strednej žiaruvzdornej misy a zalejeme vriacou vodou. Navrch položíme závažie alebo mokrú papierovú utierku, aby boli papriky ponorené. 3. Papriky scedíme a odstránime stopky a semienka. Malým nožom opatrne zoškrabeme dužinu zo šupiek. Šupky vyhodíme. Z paradajok a pečeného cesnaku stiahneme šupky.

4. Príprava v mažiari: do mažiara dáme 3 strúčiky pečeného cesnaku a 1 až 2 strúčiky olúpaného surového cesnaku. (Podľa vlastnej chuti môžeme pridať alebo ubrať pečený či surový cesnak.) Paličkou roztlčieme cesnak na pastu.
5. Pridáme chlieb a navlhčíme ho octom. Roztlčieme na pastu. Pridáme orechy a roztlčieme ich čo najjemnejšie. Výsledná zmes má mať konzistenciu hrubej pasty.

6. Vtlčieme zoškrabanú dužinu paprík a potom olúpané pečené paradajky. Vmiešame olivový olej, kým sa všetko dôkladne nespojí. Osolíme. Ak chceme redšiu a sýtejšiu omáčku, pridávame olej po 1 PL (15 ml). Podľa chuti pridáme aj viac octu.

2. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat to 177 °C. Working in batches, fry chiles until slightly darkened, about 20 seconds per batch; transfer chiles to paper towel-lined plate as each batch is finished. Remove skillet from heat and reserve. Transfer chiles to a large bowl and add boiling water to cover. Let steep for 30 minutes. Strain chiles, reserving soaking liquid.

3. Working in 3 batches, place 1/3 of the chiles, 79 ml soaking liquid, and 59 ml chicken stock into blender and purée until as smooth as possible. Set a fine-mesh strainer over a large bowl and strain chile mixture, using a rubber spatula to push through as much chile mixture as possible. Discard solids and set chile purée aside.

4. Return skillet with oil to 175 °C over medium-high heat. One at a time, fry almonds, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, and raisins until toasted, about 1 minute for almonds, 45 seconds for peanuts, 20 seconds for pumpkin seeds, and 15 seconds for raisins. Transfer each batch to a paper towel-lined plate as it is done. Transfer almonds, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, and raisins to bowl with spice mixture.

5. Fry bread until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes per side; transfer to paper towel lined-plate. Fry tortillas until golden brown, about 1 minute per side; transfer to paper towel-lined plate. Remove skillet from heat. Break bread and tortillas into small pieces and transfer to bowl with spice mixture.

6. Set fine-mesh strainer over small bowl and strain oil from skillet. Place 2 tbsp (30 ml) of strained oil to now empty skillet. Heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add in onions and cook until browned, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer onions and garlic to bowl with spice mixture, leaving as much oil in pan as possible.

7. Return skillet to medium-high heat. When oil is shimmering, add in tomatillos and tomatoes. Cook until softened, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer tomatillos and tomato to bowl with spice mixture. Add 590 ml of chicken stock to bowl with spice mixture.

8. Working in two batches, purée spice mixture in blender until as smooth as possible. Set a fine-mesh strainer over a large bowl and strain spice mixture, using a rubber spatula to push through as much spice mixture as possible. Discard solids and set spice mixture aside.

9. In a large Dutch oven or pot, heat 3 tbsp (44 ml) of reserved strained oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add in chile purée and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture has thickened to consistency of tomato paste, about 10 minutes. Stir in spice mixture, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 30 minutes. Stir in 945 ml chicken stock and chocolate. c.t: 1. Stem chiles and shake seeds into a small bowl. Tear chiles into large pieces; set aside. Place 4 tbsp (59 ml) of reserved chile seeds and sesame seeds in a small cast iron skillet set over medium heat. Toast seeds, stirring occasionally, until lightly brown, about 2 minutes. Transfer seeds to a spice grinder. Add aniseed, peppercorns, and cloves to now empty skillet. Toast until fragrant, about 1 minute; transfer to spice grinder with seeds. Add thyme, marjoram, bay leaves, and cinnamon to spice grinder. Grind all seeds and spices into a fine powder. Transfer to a large bowl; set aside.

2. Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat to 177 °C. Working in batches, fry chiles until slightly darkened, about 20 seconds per batch; transfer chiles to paper towel-lined plate as each batch is finished. Remove skillet from heat and reserve. Transfer chiles to a large bowl and add boiling water to cover. Let steep for 30 minutes. Strain chiles, reserving soaking liquid.

3. Working in 3 batches, place 1/3 of the chiles, 79 ml soaking liquid, and 59 ml chicken stock into blender and purée until as smooth as possible. Set a fine-mesh strainer over a large bowl and strain chile mixture, using a rubber spatula to push through as much chile mixture as possible. Discard solids and set chile purée aside.

4. Return skillet with oil to 175 °C over medium-high heat. One at a time, fry almonds, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, and raisins until toasted, about 1 minute for almonds, 45 seconds for peanuts, 20 seconds for pumpkin seeds, and 15 seconds for raisins. Transfer each batch to a paper towel-lined plate as it is done. Transfer almonds, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, and raisins to bowl with spice mixture.

5. Fry bread until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes per side; transfer to paper towel lined-plate. Fry tortillas until golden brown, about 1 minute per side; transfer to paper towel-lined plate. Remove skillet from heat. Break bread and tortillas into small pieces and transfer to bowl with spice mixture.

6. Set fine-mesh strainer over small bowl and strain oil from skillet. Place 2 tbsp (30 ml) of strained oil to now empty skillet. Heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add in onions and cook until browned, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Transfer onions and garlic to bowl with spice mixture, leaving as much oil in pan as possible.

7. Return skillet to medium-high heat. When oil is shimmering, add in tomatillos and tomatoes. Cook until softened, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer tomatillos and tomato to bowl with spice mixture. Add 590 ml of chicken stock to bowl with spice mixture.

8. Working in two batches, purée spice mixture in blender until as smooth as possible. Set a fine-mesh strainer over a large bowl and strain spice mixture, using a rubber spatula to push through as much spice mixture as possible. Discard solids and set spice mixture aside.

9. In a large Dutch oven or pot, heat 3 tbsp (44 ml) of reserved strained oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add in chile purée and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture has thickened to consistency of tomato paste, about 10 minutes. Stir in spice mixture, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 30 minutes. Stir in 945 ml chicken stock and chocolate. Simmer, partially covered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally. Stir in sugar and season mole with salt and additional sugar to taste. Remove from heat, use immediately or transfer to airtight container and store in refrigerator for up to a month.

1. Z čili papričiek odstránime stopky a semienka vytrasieme do malej misky. Papričky natrháme na veľké kúsky; odložíme. Do malej liatinovej panvice na strednom ohni dáme 4 PL (59 ml) odložených semienok z papričiek a sezamové semienka. Za občasného miešania ich pražíme, kým zľahka nezhnednú, asi 2 minúty. Semienka preložíme do mlynčeka na korenie. Do prázdnej panvice dáme aníz, zrnká korenia a klinčeky. Pražíme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 1 minútu; preložíme k semienkam do mlynčeka. Do mlynčeka pridáme tymian, majorán, bobkové listy a škoricu. Všetky semienka a koreniny zomelieme na jemný prášok. Preložíme do veľkej misy; odložíme.

2. V strednej panvici zohrejeme olej na stredne silnom až silnom ohni na 177 °C. Po dávkach vyprážame papričky, kým mierne nestmavnú, asi 20 sekúnd na dávku; každú dávku preložíme na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami. Panvicu odstavíme z ohňa a odložíme. Papričky preložíme do veľkej misy a zalejeme vriacou vodou. Necháme 30 minút lúhovať. Papričky scedíme a vodu z namáčania odložíme.

3. V 3 dávkach dáme do mixéra tretinu papričiek, 79 ml vody z namáčania a 59 ml kuracieho vývaru a rozmixujeme čo najjemnejšie. Na veľkú misu postavíme jemné sitko a papričkovú zmes precedíme; gumenou stierkou pretlačíme čo najviac. Zvyšky vyhodíme a papričkové pyré odložíme.

4. Panvicu s olejom znova zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni na 175 °C. Postupne opražíme mandle, arašidy, tekvicové semienka a hrozienka: mandle asi 1 minútu, arašidy 45 sekúnd, tekvicové semienka 20 sekúnd a hrozienka 15 sekúnd. Každú dávku po dopražení preložíme na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami. Mandle, arašidy, tekvicové semienka a hrozienka preložíme do misy s koreninovou zmesou.

5. Chlieb opečieme dozlatista, 1 až 2 minúty z každej strany; preložíme na tanier s papierovými utierkami. Tortilly opečieme dozlatista, asi 1 minútu z každej strany; preložíme na tanier s papierovými utierkami. Panvicu odstavíme z ohňa. Chlieb a tortilly nalámeme na malé kúsky a preložíme do misy s koreninovou zmesou.

6. Na malú misku postavíme jemné sitko a olej z panvice precedíme. Do prázdnej panvice dáme 2 PL (30 ml) precedeného oleja. Zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a za občasného miešania ju opekáme, kým nezhnedne, asi 10 minút. Vmiešame cesnak a opekáme, kým nezavonia, asi 1 minútu. Cibuľu s cesnakom preložíme do misy s koreninovou zmesou a v panvici necháme čo najviac oleja.

7. Panvicu vrátime na stredne silný až silný oheň. Keď sa olej zaleskne, pridáme tomatillos a paradajky. Za občasného miešania dusíme, kým nezmäknú, asi 10 minút. Tomatillos a paradajky preložíme do misy s koreninovou zmesou. Do misy pridáme 590 ml kuracieho vývaru.
8. V dvoch dávkach rozmixujeme koreninovú zmes v mixéri čo najjemnejšie. Na veľkú misu postavíme jemné sitko a zmes precedíme; gumenou stierkou pretlačíme čo najviac. Zvyšky vyhodíme a zmes odložíme.

9. Vo veľkom liatinovom alebo inom hrnci zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 3 PL (44 ml) odloženého precedeného oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme papričkové pyré a za stáleho miešania varíme, kým zmes nezhustne na konzistenciu paradajkového pretlaku, asi 10 minút. Vmiešame koreninovú zmes, privedieme do varu, potom oheň stlmíme na mierny a za častého miešania varíme 30 minút. Vmiešame 945 ml kuracieho vývaru a čokoládu. Varíme pod čiastočne priloženou pokrievkou 1 hodinu a občas premiešame. Vmiešame cukor a mole podľa chuti dochutíme soľou a ďalším cukrom. Odstavíme z ohňa; použijeme hneď alebo preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby a uchováme v chladničke najviac mesiac.
